name: markswift

scripts.build: bun -e 'require("node:fs").rmSync("dist", { recursive: true, force: true })' && bun build ./src/compiler/index.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/compiler.js && bun build ./src/index.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --external playwright-core && bun build ./src/cli.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js --external playwright-core && bun -e 'require("node:fs").chmodSync("dist/cli.js", 0o755)' && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test:native: MARKSWIFT_SWIFT_TESTS=1 bun test tests/integration/swift.test.ts tests/integration/responsive-compile.test.ts tests/integration/inline-link.test.ts tests/integration/compile-layouts.test.ts tests/integration/select-controls.test.ts tests/unit/swift/toggle-style.test.ts tests/unit/swift/wrapping.test.ts tests/unit/swift/radio-state.test.ts tests/unit/swift/select-controls.test.ts tests/integration/allocated-layout.test.ts tests/integration/select-lists.test.ts tests/unit/swift/select-list-transitions.test.ts tests/unit/swift/table-layout.test.ts

description: Measured HTML and CSS to native SwiftUI components
